policy: Apps that show the free revival interest card. Each entry is an existing /app/ slug matched by exact name or alias (vendor prefixes and version or edition suffixes dropped only where the rest is the same product). Listings whose own text says discontinued, abandoned, retired, end of life or no longer maintained also show the card without being listed here. Do not add an app that is still maintained.

GoPro stopped Fusion platform and camera support on 2020-11-18.

Drobo ended sales and support in January 2023; StorCentric went to Chapter 7.
GitHub sunset and archived Atom; last stable 1.60.0.
JetBrains ended sales and support; final bug-fix 2023.1.5.

BinaryAge ended development; only a volunteer build remains.
MakeMusic ended Finale development and sales on 2024-08-26 and support on 2025-08-25.
CoreCode ended support on 2026-01-01 and plans to shut the server down after 2026.
PFU ended ScanSnap Manager support on 2024-11-07 (replaced by ScanSnap Home).
Microsoft ended support for all Xamarin SDKs on 2024-05-01.
Axway says the repository is no longer maintained; last release 3.7.2 in 2018.
Studio 3T stopped Robo 3T at 1.4.4 (2021, Intel only).
Adobe ended downloads on 2025-09-30 and support and access on 2026-09-30.
